title: Notification regarding the directions with respect to mentioning of matters.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 14th August, 2025
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : in supersession of all other notifications in this regard, it is
hereby informed to the learned members of the Bar and litigants that Hon’ble The Chief
Justice is pleased to issue the following directions with respect to mentioning of matters:-
Mentioning of Division Bench matters shall be made before the concerned Division Bench.1
Mentioning of Single Bench matters shall be made before the concerned Single Bench.2
Mentioning of Division Bench or Single Bench matters involving Hon’ble The Chief Justice3
shall be made before the Division Bench of Hon’ble The Chief Justice or Single Bench of
Hon'ble The Chief Justice respectively. In case the Hon’ble Chief Justice is unavailable,
then mention shall be made before the Division Bench led by the Seniormost Judge or
before the Single Bench of the Seniormost Judge.
Mentioning shall made before the concerned Bench at the time of its sitting with
proper case number and CNR number/filing acknowledgment.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. AIIT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
